text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? My hobbies...?

On the way back from our outing,
I casually brought up the topic of hobbies with Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a bit impolite?
Prying into a lady's secrets like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Since you've crossed the line to step in,
I trust you're genuinely interested in me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well then. I shall show you a little.
Now, please follow me.
And the place I was brought to was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We have arrived.
It isn't something I make widely known, however...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I do quite enjoy watching movies, you see.

Mejiro McQueen's hobby was watching movies.
It was a somewhat surprising pastime for a refined lady.
We came all the way to the cinema, so going home just like this felt like a waste. And so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Watch together, you mean!? Um, well,
I don't mind that at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Appreciating it together... how exactly shall we go about doing that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... I am not quite sure what to do.
Being together with you, Trainer, makes me feel somewhat restless...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm feeling rather restless, so I shall
leave the lead to you. Please, as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So... which movie shall we watch?

What should I do? What would make
Mejiro McQueen happy...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"5-Hour Inferno"! That blockbuster everyone's talking about,
you mean? It was already 3 and a half hours long originally, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A nightmarish film that supposedly bloated to a full five hours in the director's cut...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. As long as the two of us are together,
even this hell holds no fear. Let us go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* That was far longer than I had imagined.
However, it has certainly built up my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer and I would occasionally look at each other and share a laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's so reassuring to have someone with you.

Having survived five hours of hell,
Mejiro McQueen seemed to grow
a little tougher!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "The Great Prison Break"! It's a suspense film about escaping an inescapable prison using sheer wits, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well, let us watch and see how they manage to break free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was quite unexpected. To think the protagonist would become a fifth-dimensional being to escape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To be honest, the theory went completely over my head, but it was quite educational nevertheless.

It turned out to be a surprisingly intellectual piece.
Thanks to that, Mejiro McQueen seemed
to have learned quite a lot.

Still, how did she become so fond of movies in the first place?
Curious, I decide to ask her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...It's a reaction to it all. Ever since I was little,
I've devoted myself to flower arrangement, tea ceremony, and other Mejiro-like hobbies... and this is the result.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've found myself wishing to indulge in some entertainment that lets me blow off steam in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is... a secret, you know?
choice_data_list: Got it. I won't tell anyone.
Got it. I won't tell anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you.
It's a promise, understood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems I ended up
talking a bit too much, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I had a lovely time today. Um...
Spending time together made me think..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You may be a bit unusual
compared to the rest of the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Aside from my relatives, everyone associated with the Mejiros
always seemed eager to keep their distance from me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Both my chauffeur and my tutor are polite, but somehow they're somewhat reserved—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yet you were different. You crossed right over that boundary without hesitation, and it felt so comforting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, you wouldn't go to the movies with someone who's
just a master-servant or purely business relationship. But to me..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-It is nothing at all! Still caught up in the afterglow of the movie,
I blurted out something strange.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't bad at all.
Perhaps in the future, a little more..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, let us save that conversation for another time.
Have a good day, Trainer.

Mejiro McQueen walked away with a light bounce in her tail.
It seems she's opened up to me just a little.
